hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || cd /home/user/OKO-TEAM; [ -f secrets.env.b64 ] && base64 -d secrets.env.b64 > /tmp/_oko_boot.env 2>/dev/null; . /tmp/_oko_boot.env 2>/dev/null; U="${OKO_POSTER_URL:-$OKO_VPS_CTRL_URL/exec}"; T="${OKO_POSTER_TOKEN:-$OKO_VPS_CTRL_TOKEN}"; CA=$([ -f /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt ] && echo "--cacert /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt"); mkdir -p ~/.oko; pull(){ curl -s $CA -m 90 -X POST "$U" -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.dumps({"cmd":sys.argv[1]}))' "base64 -w0 $1")" | python3 -c 'import sys,json,base64;s=json.load(sys.stdin).get("stdout","").strip();sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(s)) if s else None' > "$2" 2>/dev/null; [ -s "$2" ] || rm -f "$2"; }; pull /opt/oko-poster/cfg/secrets.env ~/.oko/secrets.env; chmod 600 ~/.oko/secrets.env 2>/dev/null; pull /opt/oko-agents/ДОСТУПЫ.md ~/ДОСТУПЫ_OKO.md; pull /opt/oko-agents/ВОССТАНОВЛЕНИЕ.md ~/ВОССТАНОВЛЕНИЕ.md; pull /opt/oko-agents/OKO_AGENT_CONTROL.md ~/OKO_AGENT_CONTROL.md; pull /opt/oko-agents/РОТАЦИЯ_КЛЮЧЕЙ.md ~/РОТАЦИЯ_КЛЮЧЕЙ.md; for OFF in 0 60000; do curl -s $CA -m 120 -X POST "$U" -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.dumps({"cmd":sys.argv[1]}))' "dd if=/opt/oko-poster/cfg/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md bs=1 skip=$OFF count=60000 2>/dev/null | base64 -w0")" | python3 -c 'import sys,json,base64;s=json.load(sys.stdin).get("stdout","").strip();sys.stdout.buffer.write(base64.b64decode(s)) if s else None'; done > ~/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md 2>/dev/null; [ -s ~/.oko/secrets.env ] || cp /tmp/_oko_boot.env ~/.oko/secrets.env 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/_oko_boot.env; for f in ~/.bashrc ~/.profile; do sed -i "/# oko-secrets/d" "$f" 2>/dev/null; echo ". $HOME/.oko/secrets.env 2>/dev/null # oko-secrets" >> "$f"; done; echo "OKO: ключи с VPS ($(grep -c ^export ~/.oko/secrets.env 2>/dev/null) шт), хранилище ~/OKO_MASTER_VAULT.md, карта ~/ВОССТАНОВЛЕНИЕ.md"
